W.note: Very dense 4-column Essentials grid with inline steppers and a clear bag footer, but desktop buttons and the stepper label wrap awkwardly ("Add to / bag", "1 in / bag") and names truncate.

X.note: Full storefront with search, chips, sort and a cart drawer with quantity controls, but emoji product art on pastel tiles reads generic and the large cards waste space.

Y.note: Cohesive line-art tiles, a compact bag summary with subtotal and empty-bag link, inline steppers, a reasoned sold-out note and solid focus and status handling; desktop names truncate and card heights vary.

Z.note: The most complete shopping flow (search, filter, sort, drawer with totals and shipping hint), but initials placeholder tiles, badges and tall cards feel like a template and are less compact.
